summary.purpose: Calculate Policy and Premium KPI Metrics & Reconciliation for TFG Personal Lines Reporting by matching policy and premium extracts, computing policy counts by status and product type, aggregating written/earned/unearned premiums, and validating reconciliation (Written = Earned + Unearned within 0.01 tolerance).
summary.high_level_narrative: The program opens four sequential files: POLICY-IN (policy extract), PREMIUM-IN (premium extract), KPI-OUT (KPI report), and ERROR-OUT (error/exception report). It reads the first record from each input file, then enters a merge loop that processes records in policy-number order. When policy numbers match, it increments total policy counters, classifies by status (AC, PN, EX, CN) and product type (HO, AU), accumulates premium totals (written, earned, unearned) overall and by product, and performs reconciliation check. If a policy has no matching premium record, it logs error K001; if a premium record has no matching policy, it logs error K002. Unknown status or product type generate errors K003/K004. Reconciliation mismatches beyond 0.01 generate error K005. Sequence validation ensures both input files are sorted ascending by policy number. After processing all records, it writes a formatted 80-byte KPI report with counts and premium totals, closes files, and sets return code: 12 for fatal errors, 4 for data quality errors, 0 otherwise.
summary.business_domain: Insurance - Personal Lines Policy and Premium Reporting
outputs: ERROR-OUT (Reconciliation and Sequence Error Exceptions, 80-byte records)
key_transformations: Sequential merge join on policy number between policy and premium extracts
Policy count aggregation by status: Active (AC), Pending (PN), Expired (EX), Cancelled (CN)
Policy count aggregation by product type: Homeowners (HO), Auto (AU)
Premium aggregation: Written, Earned, Unearned totals overall and by product type
Reconciliation validation: Written Premium = Earned + Unearned (tolerance 0.01)
Missing premium detection (policy without premium) -> error K001
Orphan premium detection (premium without policy) -> error K002
Data quality validation: unknown policy status -> error K003, unknown product type -> error K004
key_dependencies: No copybooks or external procedures referenced
business_rules: Policy statuses: AC=Active, PN=Pending, EX=Expired, CN=Cancelled; any other value is invalid (K003)
Product types: HO=Homeowners, AU=Auto; any other value is invalid (K004)
Reconciliation rule: Written Premium must equal Earned Premium + Unearned Premium within 0.01 tolerance (K005)
Every policy must have a matching premium record; missing premium is error K001
Every premium record must have a matching policy; orphan premium is error K002
Input files must be sorted ascending by policy number; out-of-sequence is fatal I/O error
File open/read errors are fatal (return code 12)
Data quality errors (K001-K005) set return code 4 if any occur

KPI report includes: total policies, active/pending/expired/cancelled counts, HO/AU counts, unknown status/product counts, missing/orphan/reconciliation error counts, written/earned/unearned premiums overall and by product

knowledge_profile.purpose: Calculate Policy and Premium KPI Metrics & Reconciliation for TFG Personal Lines Reporting. Processes policy extract (Task 8) and earned premium extract (Task 7) to produce monthly KPI metrics report and reconciliation/error exceptions.
key_logic: Open all four files (POLICY-IN, PREMIUM-IN, KPI-OUT, ERROR-OUT) with error handling
Read first records from both input files
Perform matched merge processing until both files reach EOF or fatal error occurs
When policy number matches: process matched record (count policies, accumulate premiums, validate status/product, reconcile premiums)
When policy number < premium number: handle missing premium (policy has no matching premium)
When policy number > premium number: handle orphan premium (premium has no matching policy)
When policy EOF: process remaining premium records as orphans
When premium EOF: process remaining policy records as missing premiums
Write KPI report with all accumulated metrics
Close all files and display summary counts

transformations.description: Validate policy status against known values (AC, PN, EX, CN)
transformations.expression: EVALUATE PI-POLICY-STATUS WHEN 'AC' ADD 1 TO WS-ACTIVE WHEN 'PN' ADD 1 TO WS-PENDING WHEN 'EX' ADD 1 TO WS-EXPIRED WHEN 'CN' ADD 1 TO WS-CANCELLED WHEN OTHER ADD 1 TO WS-UNKNOWN-STATUS, WS-DQ-ERRORS

transformations.description: Validate product type against known values (HO, AU)
transformations.expression: EVALUATE PI-PRODUCT-TYPE WHEN 'HO' ADD 1 TO WS-HO-COUNT WHEN 'AU' ADD 1 TO WS-AU-COUNT WHEN OTHER ADD 1 TO WS-UNKNOWN-PROD, WS-DQ-ERRORS

transformations.description: Accumulate premium totals across all policies
transformations.expression: ADD PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM TO WS-WRITTEN; ADD PRI-EARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-EARNED; ADD PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM TO WS-UNEARNED

transformations.description: Accumulate premium totals by product type (HO/AU)
transformations.expression: IF HO ADD premiums to HO totals; IF AU ADD premiums to AU totals

transformations.description: Premium reconciliation: Written premium must equal Earned + Unearned within tolerance of 0.01
transformations.expression: COMPUTE WS-RECON-DIFF = PRI-WRITTEN-PREMIUM - (PRI-EARNED-PREMIUM + PRI-UNEARNED-PREMIUM); COMPUTE WS-ABS-DIFF = ABS(WS-RECON-DIFF); IF WS-ABS-DIFF > WS-TOLERANCE THEN ERROR

transformations.description: Merge join of policy and premium files on policy number with three-way logic
transformations.expression: EVALUATE TRUE WHEN PI-POLICY-NO = PRI-POLICY-NO (matched) WHEN PI-POLICY-NO < PRI-POLICY-NO (missing premium) WHEN OTHER (orphan premium)

transformations.description: Sequence validation on input files - policy numbers must be in ascending order
transformations.expression: IF current policy number < previous policy number THEN SET FATAL-ERROR

business_rules: Policy status must be one of: AC (Active), PN (Pending), EX (Expired), CN (Cancelled). Any other value is a data quality error (K003).
Product type must be either HO (Homeowners) or AU (Auto). Any other value is a data quality error (K004).
Written premium must equal Earned premium plus Unearned premium within a tolerance of $0.01. Violation is reconciliation error (K005).
Input files (POLICY-IN and PREMIUM-IN) must be sorted in ascending policy number sequence. Out-of-sequence records cause fatal I/O error.
Every policy record must have a matching premium record. Missing premium is error K001.
Every premium record must have a matching policy record. Orphan premium is error K002.
Fatal errors (file open/read errors, sequence errors) terminate program with return code 12.
Data quality errors (unknown status/product, reconciliation failures) set return code 4 if any exist.
KPI metrics include: total policies, counts by status (AC/PN/EX/CN), counts by product (HO/AU), written/earned/unearned premium totals overall and by product.
dependencies: POLICY-IN file (assigned to POLIN) - Task 8 Status-updated Policy Extract
PREMIUM-IN file (assigned to PREMIN) - Task 7 Earned Premium Extract
KPI-OUT file (assigned to KPIOUT) - Monthly KPI Metrics Report output
ERROR-OUT file (assigned to ERROUT) - Reconciliation and Sequence Error Exceptions output
